name: Back to projects list
action: switchToPanel('tmprojects', true)

name: Tab: Progress
action: switchToPanel('dashboard')

name: Tab: Full settings
action: switchToPanel('settings'); shown when showSettingsTab()

name: Tab: Results
action: switchToPanel('results')

name: Reload projects list
action: loadProjects()

name: Create new project
action: onAddNewProject() → opens New project modal

name: Open existing project
action: onOpenProject() → file picker for .cfx project

name: Project row title (open project)
action: switchToPanel('dashboard') for the project; or resolveResources() if hasUnresolvedResources

name: Project row: Tasks (n) link
action: switchToPanel('dashboard') — opens the task list for this project row

name: Project row: Engine link
action: open the project's engine/dashboard

name: Project row: Results link
action: switchToPanel('results') for this project row

name: Project row context menu
action: showContextMenu($event) — opens Save/Rename/Clone/Delete/Modify symbols menu

name: Project row: Start
action: start() — runs the whole project from the list row

name: Project row: Stop
action: stop() — stops the project from the list row

name: Project row: Pause / Resume
action: pause() — pauses/resumes the project from the list row

name: Project menu: Save custom project config
action: onSave() → saveFile dialog (.cfx)

name: Project menu: Rename custom project
action: onRename() → opens Rename project modal

name: Project menu: Clone custom project
action: onClone() → cloneProject()

name: Project menu: Delete custom project
action: onRemove() → confirm → removeProject()

name: Project menu: Modify symbols
action: onModifySymbols() → opens Modify symbols modal

name: New project: Project name
action: binds project.projectName

name: New project: Create
action: onCreateProject(newProjectForm)

name: New project: Close
action: closes the modal without creating a project

name: Rename project: Project name
action: binds project.projectName

name: Rename project: Save
action: onRenameProject(renameProjectForm)

name: Rename project: Close
action: closes the modal without renaming the project

name: Modify symbols: From symbol (row)
action: binds item.symbolFrom for one mapping row (up to 10 rows, use * for wildcard)
conditional: Modify symbols modal must be open (project gear menu)

name: Modify symbols: To symbol (row)
action: binds item.symbolTo for one mapping row
conditional: Modify symbols modal must be open (project gear menu)

name: Modify symbols: Apply default settings (row)
action: binds item.applyDefaultSettings for one mapping row

name: Modify symbols: Save
action: onModifySymbols(modifySymbolsForm)

name: Add new task
action: onAddNewTask() → opens Add new task modal

name: Add task at this position
action: onAddNewTask($index+1) — inserts a task between two existing tasks

name: Select task (row)
action: onTaskSelect() → selectTask(taskType, taskName); testid is toKebabCase(task title)

name: Task active/enabled (row)
action: activateTask() — enables/disables the task in the project flow

name: Task row menu
action: showMenu($event) — opens the shared task context dropdown (#tm-tasks-dropdown-menu) and records TMTasksService.clickedTask; testid is toKebabCase(task title), same as tm-task-select-{taskTitle}

name: Task list: collapse to single column
action: onChangeDivSize(true)

name: Task list: expand to multiple columns
action: onChangeDivSize(false)

name: Task list: drag-resize handle
action: onResize($event) — drag to resize the task-list column width

name: Add new task: choose task type
action: onCreateTask(task, addIndex) — adds a task of the chosen type; testid is toKebabCase(task.NAME as returned by taskmanager/getAvailableTasks), NOT the task type

name: Add new task: copy config from existing task
action: binds config.copyFromTask (used when allowCopyFromTask is checked)

name: Add new task: Copy config from existing task
action: binds config.allowCopyFromTask

name: Add new task: Close
action: closes the modal without adding a task

name: Task menu: Clone below
action: onCloneTask('below') — clones task right after itself; needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Clone at the end
action: onCloneTask('end') — clones task to the end of the list; needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Rename task
action: onRenameTask() → opens Rename task modal; needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Delete task
action: onRemoveTask() → confirm → removeTask(); needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Copy config from task
action: onCopyFromTask() → opens Copy config from task modal (needs 2+ tasks); needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Copy config to task(s)
action: onCopyToTasks() → opens Copy config to task(s) modal (needs 2+ tasks); needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Mass apply config of this task

label.en: Mass apply config of this task

action: applyMassConfig() → opens the Apply mass config dialog for this task; needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Move task up
action: onManuallyMoveTask(-2) — moves task one position up; needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Move task down
action: onManuallyMoveTask(1) — moves task one position down; needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Run project from here
action: onRunProjectFromHere() → notifies START_PROJECT with action 'runProjectFromHere'; needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Task menu: Run this task only
action: onRunThisTaskOnly() → notifies START_PROJECT with action 'runThisTaskOnly'; needs taskTitle — it fills the projects.tasks.row.gear precondition that picks WHICH task the shared menu acts on

name: Rename task: Name
action: binds rename.newName

name: Rename task: Save
action: onRenameTaskConfirm()

name: Copy config from task: source task
action: binds config.copyFromTask

name: Copy config from task: Save
action: onCopyFromTaskConfirm()

name: Copy config to task(s): target task (row)
action: binds config.tasksCopyFrom[index].selected — marks a task as a copy target

name: Copy config to task(s): Save
action: onCopyToTasksConfirm()

name: Save
action: onSave() — shared EnginePanel config toolbar, see 02-builder cfg group

name: Save as
action: onSaveAs()

name: Load from file
action: onLoad()

name: Load saved config (menu)
action: opens saved-config dropdown, onFileSelect(config.name)

name: Mass apply config from file
action: applyMassConfig(config.name) — opens the Apply mass config from file dialog (TaskManager only)

name: Start
action: start()

name: Stop
action: stop()

name: Pause / Resume
action: pause()

name: Strategies generated
action: read-only projectStats.totalJobsDone

name: Strategies accepted
action: read-only projectStats.strategiesAccepted

name: Accepted / Passed → Detailed
action: showAcceptedStats() → projects.modal.accepted (matches both the Accepted and the TaskManager-only Passed row)

name: Rejected / Failed → Detailed
action: showDismissalStats() → projects.modal.dismissal (matches both the Rejected and the TaskManager-only Failed row)

name: Time per strategy → Detailed
action: showDurationStats() → projects.modal.duration

name: Project flow log / stats table
action: read-only — running time, in databank, per hour, project flow log Text/Visual, TaskManager Failed/Passed counts

name: Clear log
action: clearLog()

name: Clear log on start
action: onDeleteLogOnStart()

name: Memory cleanup
action: cleanupMemory()

name: Project flow log: Text
action: showTextLog() → projects.modal.text-log (TaskManager only)

name: Project flow log: Visual
action: showVisualLog() → projects.modal.visual-log (TaskManager only)

name: Accepted stats modal
action: shared EnginePanel modal — see 02-builder modal group

name: Dismissal stats modal
action: shared EnginePanel modal — see 02-builder modal group

name: Duration stats modal
action: shared EnginePanel modal — see 02-builder modal group

name: Text log modal
action: shared EnginePanel modal — see 02-builder modal group

name: Visual log modal
action: shared EnginePanel modal — see 02-builder modal group

name: Settings sub-tab: Help
action: onHelp(tab) — shows the help text for the active settings sub-tab

name: Full settings: Close
action: onClose() — closes the Full settings panel

name: Full settings: Previous sub-tab
action: instance.switchToPrevTab()

name: Full settings: Next sub-tab
action: instance.switchToNextTab()

name: Apply mass config dialog: Apply mass config
action: onApplyMassConfig() — runs the mass-apply from the popup dialog (task row / progress-toolbar trigger)

name: Apply mass config dialog: Close
action: closes the Apply mass config dialog
